alignment_law: The Memory Pyramid is a cross-cutting lifecycle overlay, not a replacement for Sourceborn typed memory classes.
Memory type, process phase, temporal stage and memory mode are orthogonal dimensions.
Encoding does not imply truth promotion.
Working memory does not imply persistent memory.
Persistence does not imply canonical truth.
Retrieval frequency does not imply epistemic support.
Procedural runtime memory does not authorize uncontrolled executable-code mutation.
Pattern learning does not automatically create a new primitive parameter.
Retrieval into a new Event does not reopen a closed Sequence.

process_phases.name: ENCODING
process_phases.meaning: Convert a locked source/Event into structured source-linked runtime objects without promoting them to truth.

process_phases.name: STORAGE
process_phases.meaning: Persist an authorized typed and versioned memory object with lineage, retention, links and index metadata.

process_phases.name: RETRIEVAL
process_phases.meaning: Retrieve typed memory references into a current working set using scope, provenance and relevance controls.

process_phases.name: REACTIVATION
process_phases.meaning: Use retrieved memory inside a new Event/Sequence working state without reopening the historical Sequence that produced the memory.

temporal_stages.name: TRANSIENT_INPUT
temporal_stages.sourceborn_role: Pre-persistence inbound source/Event material awaiting source lock and decomposition.

temporal_stages.name: ACTIVE_WORKING
temporal_stages.sourceborn_role: Current Event, Sequence and Node-Brain working sets including retrieved memories and candidate combinations.

temporal_stages.name: PERSISTENT_LONG_TERM
temporal_stages.sourceborn_role: Versioned typed MemoryObject records plus graph/index references that survive execution closure under retention policy.

memory_modes.meaning: Inspectable source-linked records about Events, claims, states, Intents, relations, evidence, contradictions and history.
Reusable execution/routing/path/pattern structures that influence future runtime without becoming factual claims or uncontrolled code mutations.
Memory containing both explicit execution history and reusable runtime structure.
Retrieval metadata pointing to authoritative memory payloads without becoming a duplicate evidence source.

seg_con_parameter_alignment.law: Segment/Container/Parameter defines source and activation structure; the Memory Pyramid defines lifecycle, temporal location and persistence mode.

validation_rules: Existing 12 memory types remain unchanged by this contract.
Encoding, Storage and Retrieval must remain distinguishable runtime phases.
T0, T1 and T2 are temporal stages and may not be counted as new memory types.
Explicit, Procedural, Mixed and Index-only are memory-mode overlays and not epistemic truth classes.
No T1 candidate may become T2 without a writeback decision.
No T2 persistence may imply truth promotion by itself.
Retrieval counters remain separate from independent support counters.
Closed Sequence references remain immutable during reactivation.
Node-local persistence does not grant global truth authority.
All persistence transitions retain source lineage and write authority.
Pattern/procedural learning cannot silently mutate executable code.
Pattern/procedural learning cannot automatically create a new primitive parameter.
